title: TRACE Bench：任务驱动的角色扮演智能体清单评估框架
summary: TRACE Bench提出任务驱动的角色扮演智能体清单评估框架，将角色档案分解为固定清单，通过用户智能体自然对话并更新清单状态，使评分可追溯至具体清单项和对话证据。相比M2基准，覆盖率从73.74%提升至99.91%，支持稳定排名和闭环基准演化。
summary_en: TRACE Bench proposes a task-driven agentic checklist evaluation framework for roleplay, decomposing role profiles into fixed checklists and using a User Agent to update states, enabling traceable scores. It achieves 99.91% coverage vs 73.74% for M2, with stable rankings and closed-loop evolution.
